instruction: In the calendar spreadsheet, highlight all dates from the 1st through the 10th of each month by setting the cell background to light blue (#add8e6). Keep all other cells unchanged.

metadata.explanation: Task variation 7: Highlight dates 1-10 in light blue. Expected to highlight 50 cells with color #add8e6. Verified by analyzing complete calendar data from cache file.
metadata.scoring_breakdown: Score = (correctly highlighted cells) / 50. Each correctly highlighted cell with the right color contributes to the score.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly dynamically identifies cells containing dates 1-10 by scanning all cells and converting values to integers (xlsx.py:46-59)
Getter correctly identifies cells with dates 11-31 to detect false positives (xlsx.py:55-59)
Metric implements both precision and recall: score = (correct_count - false_positive_count) / total_expected, penalizing both missing cells and incorrectly highlighted cells (xlsx.py:54-58)
Color verification correctly checks that cells are highlighted with the expected color #add8e6 (xlsx.py:48-49)
Evaluator fully covers both instruction requirements: 'highlight dates 1-10' (via correct_count) and 'keep other cells unchanged' (via false_positive_count)
Edge cases handled: empty result returns 0.0, no cells to highlight returns 1.0 if no false positives (xlsx.py:23-41)
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The expected.rules.cells hardcoded list (B3-F12) is not used by the metric function - the metric only uses expected.color. This is redundant but doesn't break functionality. Consider removing the hardcoded cells list from expected.rules to simplify the config.
